# Leicester Aikikai

> Traditional Aikikai aikido in Leicester, UK. A friendly club founded in May 2013.

Canonical website: https://leicesteraikikai.com

Club logo: https://leicesteraikikai.com/img/leicester-aikikai-logo-512.png (web-optimised from leicester-aikikai-main-logo.png).

## Getting started

- [Home](https://leicesteraikikai.com/): introduction, first-class guidance, fees, location, FAQs and a next-upcoming-event banner at the top of the page.
- [Start Aikido](https://leicesteraikikai.com/beginners): beginner experience, clothing, eligibility and how to attend a free introductory lesson.
- [Classes & Prices](https://leicesteraikikai.com/classes): Friday 7:00pm–9:00pm at Aylestone Leisure Centre, 2 Knighton Lane East, Leicester, LE2 6LU.
- [Contact](https://leicesteraikikai.com/contact): contact form and directions. The form uses Netlify Forms with spam filtering and a honeypot when enabled on the deployed site; local previews cannot send enquiries. Enquiries do not reserve a place in a class.

First introductory lesson is free. The club invites newcomers to come along without advance booking. Families should contact the instructor before bringing a child to confirm eligibility and availability. The club’s published guidance requires children aged 12 and under to have a parent training too. Do not infer a lower age limit from this statement.

Monthly club training fees: adult (waged) £25, adult (concession) £20, under 18 £15.
Separate annual UK Aikikai membership: adult £35, concession £27, under 18 £20. UKA membership includes liability insurance; ask the instructor about registration, cover and payment. Guest session £8. Refer to the Classes page for current information.

## Club and community

- [About Us](https://leicesteraikikai.com/about): club history, teaching approach and affiliation with United Kingdom Aikikai (UKA), part of the Joint Aikikai Council (JAC).
- [Antonios Pavlakis](https://leicesteraikikai.com/instructors/antonis-pavlakis): founder and chief instructor; started aikido in 1997. Current qualifications and certifications: 4th Dan (Yondan) (2023), Fukushidoin teaching qualification (2018), JAC Coaching Level 3 (2022), DBS (Enhanced) (2026).
- [Events](https://leicesteraikikai.com/events): upcoming courses in chronological order and a separate past-event archive. Individual URLs remain /events/YYYY-MM-DD/event-slug. Past events are historical records, not upcoming classes.
- [Blog](https://leicesteraikikai.com/blog): dojo notes and articles; individual URLs remain /blog/YYYY-MM-DD/post-slug.

## Student resources

- [Student Resources](https://leicesteraikikai.com/resources): beginner fundamentals, grading, weapons, terminology and further reading.
- [Full syllabus](https://leicesteraikikai.com/syllabus): original body-art and weapons training material, with accessible expandable grading panels. Bokken and jo detail sections start collapsed, with show/hide buttons.
- [6th kyu](https://leicesteraikikai.com/syllabus/6th-kyu)
- [5th kyu](https://leicesteraikikai.com/syllabus/5th-kyu)
- [4th kyu](https://leicesteraikikai.com/syllabus/4th-kyu)
- [3rd kyu](https://leicesteraikikai.com/syllabus/3rd-kyu)
- [UKA Welcome to Aikido booklet](https://leicesteraikikai.com/docs/welcome-to-aikido-uka-booklet.pdf)

Do not invent grading requirements, events, age policies, testimonials or insurance terms. Source content remains in src/data/events.js and src/data/blog.js; shared practical information is in src/data/club.js.

## Machine-readable content

- [Extended content summary](https://leicesteraikikai.com/llms-full.txt): generated from the same club, event and blog data used by the website. Contains event dates, venues and article text; use the event date to distinguish historical records.
- [XML sitemap](https://leicesteraikikai.com/sitemap.xml): canonical public URLs and image references.

## Technical information

Vue 3 SPA, Vue Router HTML5 history, Bootstrap 5, Vite and Netlify static hosting. Production builds include route-specific initial metadata and structured data; page bodies render with JavaScript.
Sitemap: https://leicesteraikikai.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://leicesteraikikai.com/robots.txt
Legacy home anchors /#our-journey, /#location, /#costs, /#faq and /#the-instructor remain available.
